node.title: KoalaBear m12 diagonal-socle route cut
node.closure: Scott strip dichotomy plus exact degree-12 cross-action audit
node.statement: For the degree-60 composition with five blocks of size twelve, the derived block kernel is a subdirect product of the nonabelian simple inner socles. Prime-degree block primitivity and Scott's lemma leave independent or full-diagonal socle; the actual size-four non-same-fiber suborbit excludes independence. Exact degree-12 action and exceptional M12 cross-action orbits then force one point in each of four projected blocks. Thus only (r,delta)=(4,12) survives and the r=2 Dickson branch is empty. No r4 family, owner, charge, m12, u2, cap 68, or row close is claimed.
